audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads 'HARD' while diffRating is 4/10, breakdown.difficulty says 'Favoured matchup' and the win rate is 66.67%.
audit.why: The loading-screen label is the opposite of every other field on the page.
audit.corrected: diff -> EASY. Chart itself (Skill, Skill, Ziggs, Ziggs, Skill, Skill, Kassadin) is already consistent across both layers and matches the mirror, so it is left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 stage why talks only about Ziggs' own R; Riftwalk's actual numbers (500 range, 5s at rank 1 falling to 2s at rank 3) appear nowhere.
audit.why: The whole lane is timed off how often he can blink, and the page never gives the number.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, breakdown.cooldowns and whys[4] now carry the real Riftwalk figures and the Satchel answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: TL;DR claims he has 'no shield against your AoE' — Null Sphere explicitly grants a shield that absorbs magic damage, and Void Stone reduces magic damage on top of it. Force Pulse charging off Ziggs' own casts is never mentioned.
audit.why: Ziggs is full magic damage; a Ziggs player told Kassadin has no magic mitigation will misjudge every all-in. And Q-spamming a Kassadin literally arms his Force Pulse (21s at rank 1, 400 range cone).
audit.corrected: Stated the Null Sphere shield plus Void Stone's 15% reduction in the TL;DR, and the Force Pulse charging interaction in report[5], breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[0]. Also added the Nether Blade auto-reset wind-up as the step-back tell.

edits.before: He's a melee mage with no shield against your AoE — bully him off every CS pre-6 and end before Riftwalk scales.
edits.after: Null Sphere shields him from your magic and Void Stone cuts 15% more — bully him off CS pre-6 anyway and end early.

edits.before: He's a melee mage with no shield against your AoE — bully him off every CS pre-6 and end before Riftwalk scales.
edits.after: Null Sphere shields him from your magic and Void Stone cuts 15% more — bully him off CS pre-6 anyway and end early.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Riftwalk lands at 500 range on 5s at rank 1 — hold Satchel, not R, for his blink; the 120s R is for the wave.

edits.before: Track Kassadin’s Riftwalk: His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Riftwalk blinks 500 units on 5s at rank 1; W Satchel knocks him straight back out, and your Q spam charges his Force Pulse.

edits.before: - Kassadin Riftwalk: matchup-defining — His mobility spike — the lane is decided before it scales. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Satchel has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Kassadin Riftwalk: 5s at rank 1 and 2s at rank 3 — it is never really down, so track his mana bar instead of the cooldown. - Force Pulse is 21s at rank 1 and charges off your own casts. - W Satchel, 20s at rank 1, is the answer to his blink.

edits.before: That is Kassadin’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: His Nether Blade wind-up is the tell — step back on the animation, not the cast.

edits.before: Level 6 you still control the lane since one R Riftwalk blink leaves him vulnerable to W.
edits.after: Level 6 a single Riftwalk blink of 500 range lands him right inside your W knockback.

edits.before: Pre-6 Kassadin is helpless into your poke; spam Q Bouncing Bomb and shove so he can't farm, and drop E Hexplosive Minefield to punish any walk-up under tower.
edits.after: Pre-6 spam Q Bouncing Bomb and shove so he can't farm, but every cast charges his Force Pulse (21s) — drop E on his walk-up and step back before the cone lands.

notes: Void Stone's 15% figure is carried over from the already-audited mirror (kassadin__ziggs) rather than re-derived — Riot's own text says only 'reduced magic damage'. Force Pulse charging off nearby spellcasts is straight from Riot's description and is the single most under-stated thing in this lane for a Q-spamming Ziggs. Packet levelChart (7x Ziggs) disagrees with the page chart, but the page chart matches the mirror and the win rate better, so it was left as-is.
